title: Marble from crash site tests about 40% iridium by XRF

tellings.quote: they got a very anomalous result. In fact, they got back an extremely high percentage of aridium, close to 40%.

related.note: This is the same marble and the same question of what it is made of as telling 4, but Zodakis's lab retest finds no iridium, so the two claims contradict each other.

plain: A small marble found at the site near Aztec, New Mexico, where a flying saucer is said to have crashed, reportedly came back from an X-ray fluorescence test, a scan that reads which elements are in a material, as close to 40 percent iridium, a rare metal. Michels tells this from the work of the researchers Scott Ramsey and Suzanne Ramsey, who studied the site, and calls the result "very anomalous", since that much iridium would be hard to explain for an ordinary object.
